items.title: 27.2.1 Banawat ke lihaz se proteins ki taqseem (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure-based classification of proteins (PDF 164-166).

blocks.text: Proteins amino acids ki seedhi zanjeerein hain jo peptide bonds se jureen. Peptide bond amide bond hai jo aik amino acid ke carboxyl group ke agle ke amino group se, paani kho kar, react karne se banta hai. Bohat se peptide links se bani lambi zanjeerein polypeptide chains hain, aur har protein ki khaas polypeptide chains us ki banawat aur kaam tay karti hain. Proteins ki chaar structural satahein hain.

Primary structure: polypeptide chain mein amino acids ki khaas tarteeb. Yeh tarteeb tay karti hai ke protein apni teen dimension ki shakal mein kaise mudta hai, aur is liye us ka kaam; aik amino acid ki tabdeeli bhi protein ko kharab kar sakti hai. Albumin aur insulin jaise proteins durust tarteeb par munhasir hain. Sickle-cell anaemia mein ghair maamooli haemoglobin khoon ke surkh cells ko daranti ki shakal de deta hai; yeh cells khoon ki nalein band karte aur gardish bigarte hain.

blocks.alt: Do amino acids, H2N-CH(R)-COOH aur H2N-CH(R')-COOH; pehle acid ke COOH ka OH aur doosre ke NH2 ka aik H ghere mein hain. Teer dipeptide ki taraf jata hai jis mein darmiyan ka C=O aur N-H dabbe mein 'Peptide linkage' hai, + H2O. Neeche rangeen motiyon (beads) ki lambi lari polypeptide chain ko dikhati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.4: Amino acids ke darmiyan peptide bonds se peptide chain ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle amino acid ke COOH ka OH aur doosre ke NH2 ka H mil kar paani bante hain; C=O aur N-H ke darmiyan naya C-N bond peptide linkage hai. Kitab ne dono amino acids par R chhapa lekin product mein R aur R'; is liye khaake mein doosre amino acid par R' likha gaya hai taa ke dono taraf aik jaisa ho. Motiyon ki lari mein har moti aik amino acid hai.

Secondary structure: reerh ke atoms zanjeer ke andar ya zanjeeron ke darmiyan (C=O aur N-H groups ke darmiyan) hydrogen bonds banate hain, jis se ba-qaida namoone bante hain. Alpha-helix mein hydrogen bonds aik hi zanjeer ke saath bante, lipta hua spiral (maslan keratin); beta-pleated sheet mein parosi dhaagon ke darmiyan, tah shuda chadar (maslan resham ka fibroin).

blocks.alt: Oopar: beta pleated sheet ki teen zanjeerein tah-dar (pleated) chadar par; carbon, oxygen, nitrogen aur hydrogen atoms aur R group side chains, aur aik zanjeer ke C=O aur agli ke N-H ke darmiyan tooti lakeeron (dashes) wale hydrogen bonds. Legend: carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, R group side chain, hydrogen, hydrogen bond. Neeche: alpha-helix ka feeta (ribbon) jis ke cheron (turns) ke darmiyan C=O...H-N hai, aur saath note.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.5: Primary amino acid zanjeeron se alpha-helix aur beta pleated sheets ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Helix ke saath note: helix ke chakkar C=O aur N-H groups ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se thame hain; har chakkar 3-4 hydrogen bonds se agle chakkar se jura hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beta pleated sheet mein hydrogen bonds (neeli tooti lakeerein) aik zanjeer ke C=O aur saath wali zanjeer ke N-H ke darmiyan hain, is liye zanjeerein chadar ki tarah jur jati hain. Alpha-helix mein yeh bonds aik hi zanjeer ke aik chakkar ke C=O aur agle chakkar ke N-H ke darmiyan hain. R groups sheet ki tahon (folds) se oopar neeche nikalte hain.

Tertiary structure: poori teen dimension ki shakal jo zanjeer ke side chains (R groups) ke darmiyan amal se mudne par banti hai: hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, hydrophobic interactions aur disulphide bridges. Yeh shakal kaam tay karti hai; enzymes mein active site ki theek shakal substrate ko jurne deti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: motiyon ki lari jis ke shuru par teer hai, Primary structure: zanjeer mein amino acids ke jurne ki tarteeb. Peele teer alpha-helix aur beta-pleated sheet tak jate hain, Secondary structure: primary structure ka lipatna ya tah hona. Aage teer helices, sheets aur loops wali mudi zanjeer tak, Tertiary structure: mudi zanjeer ki poori teen dimension ki shakal.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.6: Primary amino acid zanjeeron se proteins ki tertiary structure tak (kitab ki Figure 27.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ki tarteeb dekhein: primary structure (amino acids ki lari) mud kar secondary structure (alpha-helix ya beta-sheet) banati hai, aur yeh mazeed mud kar tertiary structure ki gathi shakal banate hain. Kitab ne tertiary ke neeche bhi wahi jumla chhapa jo secondary ke neeche hai; tertiary structure mudi zanjeer ki poori teen dimension ki shakal hai (kitab ki apni ta'reef), is liye khaake mein yahi likha gaya.
Quaternary structure: kuch proteins mein do ya zyada mudi zanjeerein (subunits) hydrogen bonds, ionic (salt) bridges, hydrophobic interactions aur kabhi disulphide bonds se aapas mein jurti hain.
Poori shakal ke lihaz se proteins do qismon mein bat'te hain:

items: Fibrous proteins: lambe, chhar jaise ya dhaage jaise molecules jin ki zanjeerein mutawazi aur mazboot hydrogen bonds ya disulphide bonds se reshon mein jureen. Yeh aam taur par paani mein nahi ghulte, mechanically mazboot aur mustahkam hain, aur dhaanchay ke polymers ka kaam karte hain, maslan collagen (connective tissue), keratin (baal, nakhun, jild) aur myosin (muscle). Baalon ka keratin aur resham ka fibroin learning outcomes mein naam liye gaye fibrous proteins hain.

Globular proteins: poora molecule gol ya baizawi hota hai. Zyada tar 'kaam karne wale' (functional) proteins, jaise enzymes, hormones aur ghizai proteins, globular hain. Yeh garmi aur pH ke liye zyada hassas hain: anday ki safedi garam karne par sakht ho jati hai kyunke zanjeeron ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds toot'te aur zanjeerein khul jati hain, aur doodh ka protein casein lemon ka ras pH kam karne par jam jata hai. Yeh proteins ka denaturation hai.

blocks.prompt: Alpha-helix ko us ki shakal mein kaun thaamta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aik peptide link ke C=O aur usi zanjeer mein chand amino acids aage doosre peptide link ke N-H ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds.

items: Primary: amino acids ki tarteeb (peptide bonds).
Secondary: alpha-helix aur beta-sheet (hydrogen bonds); tertiary: R groups ke amal se mudna; quaternary: kai zanjeerein.
Fibrous (collagen, keratin) aur globular (enzymes, hormones); garmi ya pH se denaturation.
